CEDAR COUNTY PROBATION DEPARTMENT
PRESENTENCE REPORT
To the Superior Court, People v. Example
Prepared by Probation Officer Rowan
Police say a witness described a blue bag. The witness interview was not sworn testimony.
name: PRESENTENCE REPORT

text:
PROPOSED FINDINGS AND ORDERS
If convicted, probation recommends supervised treatment rather than custody. No defendant interview was available. The report proposes 24 actual and 12 conduct credits; counsel claims 28 actual days. Restitution of $300 is requested, not ordered; a fine is recommended separately. The court has not adopted these proposals.

ADDENDUM
Cedar County Probation Officer Rowan to the Superior Court
A treatment bed is now available. Recommendation unchanged.
name: ADDENDUM
